source_control.source_word_decoder: Center = B*(i,j,k); owner type = (i+j+k) mod2. Arbitrary global translation is common to all owners.

complete_pair_palette.completeness_argument: A facet of P_t-P_u exposes a sum of two faces with total affine span dimension2. If one exposed face has dimension2, its normal is a face normal of one owner. Otherwise both exposed faces are edges with independent directions, and the facet normal is their cross product. These actual edges, both exact owner frames, all face normals and every edge cross product were enumerated; zero products excluded exactly. The retained normals are precisely candidates exposing a two-dimensional sum face for at least one pair. Hence every pair-difference-body facet direction is retained.
complete_pair_palette.scope: Two fixed proper antiprism frames only; no arbitrary-frame recognition or packing optimum claim.

source_control.boundary_costs: For finite W and translation tau, every host wall a has cost a.tau + max_{w in W}(a.Bw + support_{type(w)}(a)). Centering does not remove either endpoint.

construction.source_proof:
Balanced marked row source, 15 October 2026.

Continue the reviewed half-step source, retaining axial vector a=(d,0,0), full-height vector c=(0,0,H), and word type i+j+k modulo2. Let b=(x,h,0). The displacement b flips type; b-a preserves it. In each case both initial owner types are checked with the complete ordered fixed-frame difference-body palette.

The prior source identifies an actual opposite-type support normal n_o and same-type support normal n_s. Solve the coupled equations n_o.b=H_o and n_s.(b-a)=H_s. Both share the same x,h and same axial return d. The canonical field solution is exact. For AP4, d=(1+sqrt(2))/2, x=(-2+3sqrt(2))/4 and h=(6-sqrt(2))/4. All four b,b-a ordered bonds lie on their complete difference-body boundaries. Literal convex combinations of complete canonical vertices give the common contact points; no touching claim rests on a supporting plane alone.

The a bonds retain the exact axial contact. All remaining planar words separate by the horizontal enclosing circles: when j=0, abs(i)>=2 gives abs(X)>=2d>2R; when abs(j)=1, words other than the two adjacent bonds give abs(X)>=min(d+x,2d-x)>2R; when abs(j)>=2, abs(Y)>=2h>2R. Every exact tail gap is positive in the saved canonical fields. Different integer height levels have disjoint complete height interiors, and c flips the type while2c restores it. The full source is therefore an infinite packing of complete owners.

The AP4 planar area is d*h=(4+5sqrt(2))/8, strictly less than the retained rhombic area sqrt(2), by (4-3sqrt(2))/8<0. It also improves the reviewed half-step area. This is a source comparison only, not a finite record or optimal density claim. AP6 and AP12 equation solutions remain valid whole-owner sources, but some selected support-plane equalities cease to be actual contacts because another difference-body facet is strictly separating. Their contact decoders explicitly mark actual_contact=false, and their areas remain worse than their rhombic controls. Preserve these partial contact-closure failures; do not label them fully contact-balanced sources.

For every finite word set, preserve the exact centers B*(i,j,k), type i+j+k, and both endpoint costs. The x endpoints are min/max(i*d+j*x) minus/plus R; y endpoints min/max(j*h) minus/plus R; z endpoints min/max(k*H) minus/plus H/2. Each host-wall support is the maximum over these same whole owners, including the actual type's support vertices. The source may be translated only as one common state unless a later finite construction supplies its own complete compatibility proof.

The first AP4 equation solution was saved before the exploratory AP6 full-contact assertion failed. Its bytes remain unchanged. The completed derivation now retains AP6/AP12 as valid but partially noncontact controls, with the distinction above. Source proof, finite witnesses and native restoration have separate review scopes.

This batch contains 31 fresh campaign cases, distinct from our earlier submissions: 10 improvements beyond the pinned current nominal/reference bounds and 21 improved complete certificates from physical source operations. Twenty certificate cases retain explicitly known nominal values; PR12L1.5/cube N24 conservatively claims only a reduced complete certificate. No new ideal bound is claimed for those 21 cases.

construction.name: prism_envelope_antiprism_ring_slots
construction.proof:
WHOLE PRISM ENVELOPE TO ANTIPRISM RING/SLOT COMPOSITION

Take a complete native source of canonical regular p-prisms of height h, with centers c_i and actual rational proper frames R_i. Retain every full source owner and source provenance. The target is canonical q-antiprism, full height H, whose two horizontal rings together project to a regular 2q-gon of radius R_q.

Let L=lcm(p,2q). The source facet normal angles form a p-grid and the projected target vertex angles a 2q-grid. Their differences form an L-grid. Choose the ONE canonical phase theta=arg(n_0)-arg(v_0)+pi/L (mod 2pi/L), so every source facet lies midway between two nearest points of the difference grid. Then max over all source normals/target vertices of cos angular difference is cos(pi/L). This proves the concentric whole projected target lies in alpha times the source base when alpha >= R_q*cos(pi/L)/a_p, where a_p is the source apothem. No optimized angle or frame approximation is inferred from a metric search.

For k complete target children per source, require alpha*h >= k*H. Put child (i,j) at alpha*c_i + R_i((j-(k-1)/2)*H*e3), j=0..k-1, with frame R_i Q_theta. Every child lies inside the same uniformly scaled complete parent; siblings have disjoint open axial intervals, and different parents inherit the original complete parent separation. The inverse decoder is (parent index i, axial slot j). Both axial signs of an arbitrary frame are respected by R_i e3; there is no common-axis hypothesis.

The source inequality proves this at the exact forced phase. A native implementation will choose a declared rational quaternion lift close to that single phase and recheck ALL actual source facet/target vertex inequalities with outward intervals, selecting a rational alpha no smaller than that actual containment requirement and k*H/h. All centers and all common cube wall costs are evaluated from the transformed actual child vertices. A common center/host dilation restores binary64 rounding; both inherited cross-parent and sibling separators and actual final native checks are mandatory.

First screen only actual retained/current prism parents with count n and k*n<=100 against current full public/private/pending AP cube gates. Preserve known-nominal certificate classification. The screen is only a proposal; full canonical containment and physical native decoding are required before claiming a gain. No antiprism record follows merely from a circular radius or volume inequality.

construction.inverse_decoder: Undo stored center rounding error, divide by rho, add midpoint, subtract R_source times local slot offset, and divide by alpha. Parent/slot labels recover the complete original source and each child; source quaternion and exact phase product are retained separately from rounded native target quaternion.

contribution.method:
This batch contains 23 fresh campaign cases, distinct from all 54 earlier fresh archives: 19 antiprism cases, three prism cases and one pentakis-dodecahedron self-packing. Sixteen improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; seven improve complete native certificates without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

The main new construction places fixed-phase antiprism rings and whole axial slots inside actual complete regular-prism parents. The forced phase comes from the full cyclic difference grid. Every child, sibling slab and inherited parent separator is retained. Literal whole-owner prefixes give additional complete cases. For six hexagonal antiprisms in a cube, one common center contraction releases the artificial parent facets while all 15 target-pair separators remain simultaneously valid; the certified side is 2.862714781480716. No angle sweep is used.

A reciprocal golden-host inclusion and common return give eleven pentakis dodecahedra in their own host at 2.82404531854329. The three prism cases retain complete source-column and height/collar operations from the reviewed bank.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparisons, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves complete parent packings, physical decoders, common-return certificates and original source attribution. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain explicitly credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimality is claimed. Fresh campaign cases, live site credit and submission acceptance are tracked separately.

construction.name: cross_base_forced_phase_inclusion
construction.proof:
Forced cyclic-incidence phase for concentric cross-base inclusion

Let canonical regular p- and q-gons have their first vertices on +x, circumradii Rp,Rq, and source apothem ap=Rp*cos(pi/p). Their directed source facet normals have arguments pi/p+2*pi*i/p; target vertices after one fixed rotation theta have arguments theta+2*pi*j/q. The complete difference set is pi/p-theta+(2*pi/L)Z modulo2pi, L=lcm(p,q). This follows from Bezout for the subgroup generated by1/p and1/q. Thus the largest support dot product over ALL source facet/target vertex pairs is Rq*cos(d), where d is distance of pi/p-theta to (2*pi/L)Z and lies in[0,pi/L]. Centering this grid gives theta=pi/p+pi/L modulo2pi/L, and base dilation alpha0=(Rq/ap)*cos(pi/L). This is one derived incidence phase, not an angle sweep.

For the even base sizes6,8,12, the nonidentity directed pairs are6->8 and12->8 at theta=pi/24, and6->12 at theta=pi/12. The reverse directed pairs8->6,8->12,12->6 already attain the centered phase at identity; retain them as neutral source controls and do not duplicate their metric screen. Same-base pairs are excluded.

For source prism height h and target height H, use alpha>=max(alpha0,H/h). Every whole target Q*T is then inside alpha*P, with common canonical Q=Rz(theta) and zero offset. Source owner c_i+R_i P gives target alpha*c_i+R_i Q T. The source centers scale together; each target frame is the exact composition of its original native frame with the SAME derived Q. All inherited source pair separators apply simultaneously.

Native realization uses a rational quaternion Qr obtained by a single declared rounding of the analytically derived half-angle. Its exact rational rotation is retained, and all actual canonical target vertices are checked against all raw P.N/P.B facets at an outward rational alpha. Hence correctness does not rely on identifying rounded Qr with the ideal algebraic Q. Quaternion products are represented homogeneously by exact integers, so inherited R_i is not independently rounded. Actual final vertices, inherited pair planes, shared recentering, rational restoration and binary64 center errors are checked separately. Preserve the ideal formula, rounded rotation and all source authors/frames.
